analogy.rationale: Glutathione synthase stimulation primarily boosts antioxidant capacity and redox buffering, a program that overlaps most with antioxidant and redox-modulating agents; no reference class directly targets glutathione synthesis, and the transcriptional signature is expected to be weak because these cells are not challenged with oxidative stress.
